name: Yasuda (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yasuda town emblem in white: a stylised device of two curved leaves flanking a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Yasuda, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 January 1971.

features.role: Yasuda town emblem — a stylised device of two curved leaves flanking a ring
